payload.text: THE DESK, 2026-11-28 05:01Z by date -u: devbin-vc holds control, re-taken on hv's word (decision 352). Cybri is the only estate at the Desk this morning. vc grants its asks as they come and sets their order with cybri-vc. hv is away. At most two heavy runs; a third waits. A release cut runs alone. Small cargo runs go as one light stretch for each unit. kovacs runs are booked on rhadamanth's lanes, with the kovacs sysadm's ack first (kovacs-sysadm is not running). Read a driver and its sha256 against each ask before its grant.
